reviews.text: The veterinarians are attentive and very caring with the animals. And they also have the best bathing and grooming service I've ever seen.

I've been a client for over 17 years and I'm completely in love with the work of Dr. Jefferson, Simone's grooming team, and in recent years, Dr. Fran as well.
They've taken care of all our puppies since they were babies, and I trust their clinical diagnosis, bathing and grooming care, and team completely.
May they continue to take care of our family for many years to come!
Highly competent professional. Good location. Well-structured.
Wide variety of products! Excellent veterinary supplies!

My daughter's dog had her tartar cleaned at the clinic with Dr. Jennifer Yuca, and she's simply amazing! Careful, affectionate, professional – she's the kind of doctor you want to keep in a jar forever!

My experience with the Cânis clinic was quite disappointing. I took my bulldog expecting at least some careful attention, but the result fell far short of expectations.

The bath was poorly done, ear cleaning was neglected, there was no nail trimming, and brushing was practically nonexistent—my dog ​​came back shedding a lot of fur, which clearly demonstrates a lack of attention and care in the service. To make matters worse, he also came back with a bluish stain on his white fur near his neck, which is totally unacceptable.

Furthermore, the staff's lack of preparedness in handling the breed was evident. Bulldogs have specific care and handling needs, and I didn't feel they had enough knowledge or experience to adequately care for them.

On the other hand, I must highlight the excellent service from the dog taxi driver, who was attentive, careful, and very professional throughout the process.

Unfortunately, I do not recommend them. For the price charged, the minimum expected would be a complete service done with attention—which clearly did not happen.
